text:
</sub>  Include human-only confirmed defects in recall

When adjudication records a valid defect found directly by a human but absent from the external, sweep-on, and sweep-off reviews, this denominator omits the defect and therefore inflates both configurations' recall. The fresh uncovered case is explicitly supported by the dependency contract, whose `ronda_miss` outcome includes a real issue found by “another reviewer or human” (`20260910143722_24-review-quality-benchmark-suite_specs.md:247-250`). Define the denominator as all recorded human-confirmed defects on the cohort heads, including defects no compared reviewer reported.
rationale: Author fixed it: Fixed at 6b27ef7. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
